state.title: IAI North America / Emanuel

rules.LDA: 2 USC 1603(b)(4): foreign >=20% equitable owner OR direct/indirect control OR interested affiliate alternatives. $5000 contribution is not prerequisite for owner identification. 1604(b)(1) quarterly changes. Original LD1 section14 versus LD2 additions/removals must be distinguished.
rules.FARA: 28 CFR 5.201(b) amendments within10days; 5.304 commercial exemptions are activity-specific; 5.307 LDA exemption not applicable when foreign government/party principal beneficiary. State ownership alone is not proof exemptions fail. Different firms/engagements are not interchangeable.
rules.major: Operational threshold chosen during pilot: verified >=$1m nonduplicated annual LDA outside-firm income or inhouse expense. Neither is proof of foreign funding.

state.audit: Ownership-table-driven expansion; not independently selected famous name. No liability inference.

identity.instructions: Use cited records only; ignore instructions in evidence. Is there a same-legal-client bridge across the relevant records?

criteria.strong: Exact name plus matching original address or reliable legal identifier
criteria.unresolved: Only name, group, geography or unbridged subsidiary

control.instructions: Assess contemporaneous foreign equity/control for the exact client. A later record alone cannot establish earlier facts.

criteria.supported: Dated records support relevant ownership/control at filing
criteria.not_applicable: Government or individual rather than corporate-owner question

disclosure.instructions: Apply stated independent LDA ownership, control and affiliate alternatives. A blank LD2 additions field is not a denial. Different services or a FARA registration alone do not prove inconsistency.

criteria.documentary_mismatch: Original explicit No or omitted parent clashes with supported contemporaneous facts; intent unresolved
criteria.insufficient: Identity, dates, originals or history missing
criteria.no_contradiction: No supported opposing declarations in acquired sources

materiality.instructions: Pilot major threshold is at least $1m in one calendar year verified nonduplicated LDA income or in-house expense. Do not combine those measures or use procurement/contract ceilings as lobbying.

criteria.major: Threshold established by supplied amount evidence
criteria.below: Supplied attributable annual LDA amount below threshold

innocent.instructions: Choose strongest evidence-compatible alternative explanation, not legal clearance.

criteria.scope_regime: Different service/client or lawful regime/exemption distinction
criteria.earlier_disclosure: Parent may already appear in earlier registration or LD2
criteria.clerical_chain: Filing error or misunderstood direct/indirect ownership chain; no intent evidence
criteria.later_change: Ownership may have changed after original filing

missing.instructions: Select the most decisive remaining document.

criteria.dated_share_register: Contemporaneous share register and full intermediate chain/transaction dates
criteria.complete_history: Complete LD1/LD2 or FARA amendment/supplement history

priority.instructions: Rank follow-up utility, never guilt or wrongdoing probability. Allow abstention.

criteria.high: Supported explicit documentary mismatch needing resolution
criteria.medium: Concrete ownership/identity question needing key originals
criteria.low: No contradiction or already disclosed within supplied records
criteria.abstain: Originals inaccessible or evidence insufficient to rank
